status: Delivery-hardening batch complete. A fresh-eyes audit of the probe's delivery surfaces found and fixed three contract defects and pinned every previously unpinned claim. (1) The README promised --rounds accepts only pure decimal integers, but strtoul silently accepted 02000, +2000 and a whitespace-prefixed value; the parser now requires the first character to be a digit 1-9 and all six shapes (0, 02000, +2000, leading whitespace, -1, overflow) exit 2, measured one by one on the live binary. (2) tq-clock-rate let the kernel write a word allocated with hipHostMallocDefault, which this machine returns with flags=0 (NOT device-mapped) while the write still lands - a platform accident of exactly the class the probe exists to refuse (AXIOM 1); the tool now requests mapped host memory, verifies the Mapped flag per device, and reads the word with an acquire load; the measured rates are unchanged (2255.6-2320.4 MHz across the reruns, median 2319.8-2320.2 MHz). (3) cmake --install shipped the two binaries, README and LICENSE but not validate-report.py, the validator the README's operator contract requires before archiving; it is now installed and a scratch-prefix smoke proved the installed tree stands alone (installed binary ran 50 rounds qualification=pass; the installed validator accepted the installed binary's report). Additionally: write_file_exclusive's documented symlink refusal and missing-directory refusal were never pinned - config-test now covers both (link and victim survive byte-identical); the validator's robustness against malformed trees was never pinned - a 6000-mutation fuzz over both documents produced zero unexpected exceptions, and a bounded 2x500 fixed-seed version now lives inside --self-test; HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES out-of-range indices (1, 5, 99) were measured to take the same enumeration-failure path as whitespace/empty, while a list containing non-existent indices (0,1,2,3,5 on this one-device machine) is silently filtered - the operator can only catch that typo via the device count and per-card BDF in the report, which the README now says. The registry stays at 25 cases; the authoritative evidence was rerun from the final formatted source in a fresh tree.
